richtext.text: BASIC-DROID is like an annoying little fly that pops up everywhere. This little fly will relentlessly chase you from the beginning to the end of the game and deal damage on collision. HP: 50, DMG: 50, SPD: 3, EXP: 1x

gearText.values: BASIC-DROID is like an annoying little fly that pops up everywhere. This little fly will relentlessly chase you from the beginning to the end of the game and deal damage on collision. HP: 50, DMG: 50, SPD: 3, EXP: 1x|ELITE-DROID is a somewhat annoying type that appears much less frequently than BASIC-DROID. There's a chance it will appear every second, and this chance increases as time progresses. Of course, its terrifying appearance also makes it somewhat sluggish. HP: 150, DMG: 75, SPD: 2.25, EXP: 5x|BOSS-DROID is by far the most terrifying of all DROID's. Aside from its enormous size, its overwhelming power makes it a fearsome figure. But don't worry. After all, BOSS-DROID can only appear once every 5 minutes (300 seconds). A friendly reminder: If you're unlucky, you might encounter 2, or even more... HP: 500, DMG: 150, SPD: 1.75, EXP: 50x|Health is a reliable tool that shows you how far you are from losing the game. At the start of the game, health is 100. Each damage upgrade increases the health value by 25. Additionally, each level you gain completely restores your health.|Damage represents how much damage a character's arrow deals. At the start of the game, damage is 25. Each damage upgrade increases the damage value by 5.|Attack Speed ​​is a value that indicates how fast a character fires arrows. At the start of the game, Attack Speed is 1. Each Attack Speed ​​upgrade increases the Attack Speed ​​value by 20%.|Movement Speed ​​is a value that indicates how fast a character moves. At the start of the game, movement speed is 6. Each Movement Speed ​​upgrade increases the Movement Speed ​​value by 2.|Dash is a unique ability that is critically important at every stage of the game. It allows the character to dash in the direction they are walking. The good news is: this dash is proportional to the character's movement speed. CD: 2|Burn is a relatively ineffective ability compared to other abilities in the game. Surprisingly, Burn deals damage proportionally to its duration. It deals 1.5 damage in every 0.1 seconds. Particularly effective against ELITE-DROIDS and BOSS-DROIDS, Burn will burn all your dreams. CD: 30, DUR: 2|Speed ​​is the only ability that will save your life in a prolonged game. Speed ​​increases your attack speed by 20%. This means that the higher your base attack speed, the more effective it will be. CD: 35, DUR: 4|Multishot is a fantastic ability that increases the number of arrows you fire. However, this increase also changes the angle of the arrows, firing them in a funnel shape. Each arrow can trigger the same targeting effects. Multishot is powerful, but it becomes broken when combined with other abilities. CD: 45, DUR: 3|Rage is like a character's superpower. Rage is an ultimate that activates abilities on its own, without being affected by the cooldown or duration of other abilities. However, it does so at a reduced power level. Each activated ability is at 75% power. CD: 60, DUR: 5|Cooldown is a super upgrade option that directly affects the cooldown time of abilities. Cooldown reduces the cooldown of the relevant ability by 5% per level.|Duration is a elegant upgrade option that appears in-game and affects the active duration of abilities, extending their primary power. Duration, increases the duration of the relevant ability by 10%.|Effect is a powerful upgrade option that increases the effects of abilities, and it has a different effect on each ability. In Burn: damage increases by 1. In Speed: speed multiplier increases by 20%. In Ricochet: bounce count increases by 1. In Multishot: arrow count increases by 1. In Rage: reduced power increases by 10%.
gearText.default: Ricochet, as the name suggests, is an excellent ability that adds a ricochet effect to arrows. The arrows will be directed to the nearest target upon hitting the first enemy. The starting ricochet rate is 1. CD: 40, DUR: 3
